- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000217" [constraint]: The authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC per the change policy.  (about: authentication gateway)
